items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... I mean, this is Beth Russ. Huh? [INTERVIEWEE] Got all these girls working for her over there? Yes, she got three houses. Running houses and everything.

ctx.x: Three houses with the girls. Three houses, huh? Yeah. I mean, this is Beth Russ. Huh?

Got all these girls working for her over there? Yes, she got three houses. Running houses and everything. Oh. I thought you meant sporting houses. I got a lot of them. I got a lot of them. I don't know what I'm going to name. This is Beth Russ.
The cracker jacked. The cracker jacked seems to be the place, huh? That's where you go to get it. Yeah, the cracker jacked.
